question: 'Anandamath' is a famous ___________ novel which was written by Bankim Chandra Chatterjee.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bengali**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Anandamath** is a famous **Bengali** novel written by **Bankim Chandra Chatterjee**.
 
• It was first published in **1882 **and has since been considered a cornerstone of Bengali literature.
 
• The novel is set in the backdrop of the **Sannyasi Rebellion **in the late 18th century and is known for its patriotic theme.
 
• Bankim Chandra Chatterjee is one of the most notable authors in Bengali literature and has made significant contributions to the Indian literary canon.
 
• The novel also includes the famous song "**Vande Mataram**," which later became a national song of India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Bankim Chandra Chatterjee was born on 27 June 1838 and is considered one of the greatest novelists in Indian literature.
 
• He was a key figure in the literary renaissance of Bengal and was one of the first to write in both Bengali and English.
 
• Besides "Anandamath," some of his other notable works include "**Durgeshnandini**," "**Kapalkundala**," and "**Krishnakanter Will**."
 
• His works often explored themes of nationalism, social reform, and the cultural heritage of Bengal.
 
• Bankim Chandra Chatterjee passed away on 8 April 1894, leaving behind a rich legacy of literary works that continue to inspire generations.
